## Installation

statlingo's R package isn't yet on CRAN (it was previously published there
under the name `statlingua`; a resubmission under the new name is
pending). Install the development version from GitHub:

```r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("bgreenwell/statlingo/r")
```

You'll also need the [ellmer](https://cran.r-project.org/package=ellmer)
package to create an LLM client:

```r
install.packages("ellmer")
```

## Quick example

```{r}
#| eval: false
library(statlingo)

# Fit a simple linear model
fm <- lm(dist ~ speed, data = cars)

context <- "
The data give the speed of cars (mph) and the distances taken to stop
(ft). Note that the data were recorded in the 1920s!
"

# Create an ellmer chat client (requires an API key -- see
# ?ellmer::chat_openai or ?ellmer::chat_google_gemini for provider setup)
client <- ellmer::chat_openai()

# Get an explanation tailored for a student audience
ex <- explain(
  fm,
  client = client,
  context = context,
  audience = "student",
  verbosity = "detailed"
)

print(ex)
```
